title: Lithium Nephrotoxicity, Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus & Electrolyte Masterclass
description: 整合 Lithium-induced NDI, Chronic Tubulointerstitial Nephritis, Microcysts, Hyperparathyroidism, dRTA 與 Hemodialysis 處置之專科課程。

sections.title: Module 1: Molecular Pathophysiology of Lithium-Induced Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus (NDI) & Management
sections.content:
### 1. Molecular Pathophysiology Matrix

Lithium 進入 Principal Cells 主要透過 Epithelial Sodium Channel (ENaC)。進入細胞後，Lithium 會抑制 Glycogen Synthase Kinase-3beta (GSK-3beta) 活性，進而干擾 Aquaporin-2 (AQP2) 的生成與 Apical Membrane 插入，導致 Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus (NDI)。臨床表現為 Polyuria 與 Polydipsia。

| Mechanism | Key Receptor/Channel | Consequence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Apical Entry | Epithelial Sodium Channel (ENaC) | Intracellular Lithium Accumulation |
| Intracellular Target | Glycogen Synthase Kinase-3beta (GSK-3beta) Inhibition | Reduced Aquaporin-2 (AQP2) Transcription & Trafficking |
| Phenotype | Aquaporin-2 (AQP2) Downregulation | Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus (NDI) |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature | Central Diabetes Insipidus | Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ADH Secretion | Decreased | Normal to High |
| Copeptin Level | Low | High |
| Desmopressin Response | Significant increase in Urine Osmolality | Minimal or no change in Urine Osmolality |
| Treatment | Desmopressin | Amiloride, Thiazide, NSAIDs |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Polyuria ➔ Check Serum Osmolality & Urine Osmolality ➔ Serum Hyperosmolar & Urine Hyposmolar ➔ Suspect Diabetes Insipidus ➔ Administer Desmopressin ➔ No Response ➔ Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus ➔ History of Bipolar Disorder ➔ Suspect Lithium ➔ Management ➔ Stop Lithium (if possible), Administer Amiloride to block ENaC.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 以為治療 Lithium 造成的 Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus 首選是 Desmopressin。
**Analysis**: 由於是 Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus，Desmopressin 無效。首選治療是 Amiloride，因為它可以阻斷 Epithelial Sodium Channel (ENaC)，減少 Lithium 進入 Principal Cells。

sections.title: Module 2: Chronic Tubulointerstitial Nephritis, Renal Microcysts & Glomerular Lesions
sections.content:
### 1. Pathology Matrix

長期使用 Lithium 容易引發 Chronic Tubulointerstitial Nephritis (CTIN)，並伴隨 Renal Microcysts，特別是在 Distal Tubules 與 Collecting Ducts 產生。在 Glomerular 病變方面，偶見 Minimal Change Disease (MCD) 或是 Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis (FSGS)，表現為 Nephrotic Syndrome。

| Lesion Type | Characteristic Finding | Clinical Presentation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tubulointerstitial | Chronic Tubulointerstitial Nephritis (CTIN) | Slowly progressive Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) |
| Cystic | Renal Microcysts | Detected on MRI T2, often punctate cortical cysts |
| Glomerular | Minimal Change Disease (MCD), Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) | Nephrotic Syndrome, Proteinuria |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Disease | Cyst Location & Size | Associated Findings |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lithium Nephrotoxicity | Microcysts, Distal Tubule & Collecting Duct | Chronic Tubulointerstitial Nephritis, Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus |
| Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease (ADPKD) | Macrocysts, throughout nephron | Hepatic Cysts, Intracranial Aneurysm |
| Acquired Cystic Kidney Disease (ACKD) | Small to moderate cysts | End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD), Dialysis history |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Chronic Kidney Disease in Lithium Patient ➔ Perform Renal Ultrasound or MRI ➔ Findings: Renal Microcysts & Cortical Fibrosis ➔ Diagnosis: Lithium-induced Chronic Tubulointerstitial Nephritis ➔ Check Urinalysis ➔ Heavy Proteinuria ➔ Suspect concurrent Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) or Minimal Change Disease (MCD) ➔ Consider Renal Biopsy for definitive diagnosis.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 以為 Lithium 只會造成 Tubulointerstitial 損傷而不會有 Glomerular Lesions。
**Analysis**: 雖然 Chronic Tubulointerstitial Nephritis 最為典型，但也可能引發 Nephrotic Syndrome，尤其是 Minimal Change Disease (MCD) 或 Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis (FSGS)。

sections.title: Module 3: Endocrine, Divalent Cation & Acid-Base Disturbances
sections.content:
### 1. Endocrinology Matrix

Lithium 會使 Parathyroid Gland 的 Calcium-Sensing Receptor (CaSR) 敏感度下降，導致 Set-Point 改變，引發 Hyperparathyroidism 伴隨 Hypercalcemia 與 Hypocalciuria。此外，Lithium 亦可能干擾 Distal Tubule 的酸化作用，引發 Distal Renal Tubular Acidosis (dRTA Type 1)。

| Disturbance | Mechanism | Manifestation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hyperparathyroidism | Calcium-Sensing Receptor (CaSR) Set-Point Shift | Hypercalcemia, Elevated Parathyroid Hormone (PTH) |
| Calcium Excretion | Enhanced Tubular Reabsorption | Hypocalciuria |
| Acid-Base | Distal H+ Secretion Defect | Distal Renal Tubular Acidosis (dRTA Type 1) |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Condition | Serum Calcium | Urine Calcium | Parathyroid Hormone (PTH) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary Hyperparathyroidism | High | High or Normal | High |
| Familial Hypocalciuric Hypercalcemia (FHH) | High | Low | Normal to slightly High |
| Lithium-induced Hypercalcemia | High | Low | High |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Hypercalcemia in a Lithium Patient ➔ Check Parathyroid Hormone (PTH) ➔ Elevated ➔ Suspect Lithium-induced Hyperparathyroidism ➔ Check Urine Calcium ➔ Hypocalciuria ➔ Confirms Calcium-Sensing Receptor (CaSR) shift mimicry ➔ Check Acid-Base Status ➔ Normal Anion Gap Metabolic Acidosis ➔ Suspect concomitant Distal Renal Tubular Acidosis (dRTA Type 1).

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 看到 Hypercalcemia 伴隨高 Parathyroid Hormone (PTH)，直覺以為是 Primary Hyperparathyroidism 而忽略 Lithium 影響。
**Analysis**: Lithium 會造成類似 Familial Hypocalciuric Hypercalcemia (FHH) 的表現，引發 Hypercalcemia 與 Hypocalciuria，因為其作用於 Calcium-Sensing Receptor (CaSR)。需仔細區分並評估停藥可能性。

sections.title: Module 4: Toxicokinetics, Acute Intoxication & Hemodialysis Decision Matrix
sections.content:
### 1. Toxicokinetics Matrix

Lithium MW 7 Da 且 0% Protein Binding 的特性，使其易於透過 Hemodialysis (HD) 清除。然而，由於其 Volume of Distribution (Vd ~0.8 L/kg) 且依賴 Intracellular Compartment 的重新平衡，透析後常出現 Rebound Phenomenon。當發生 Acute Intoxication 時，應積極評估 Renal Replacement Therapy (RRT) 之指徵。

| Characteristic | Implication for Dialysis | Clinical Consideration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Molecular Weight (7 Da) | Highly Dialyzable | Hemodialysis (HD) is very effective for rapid clearance |
| Protein Binding (0%) | 0% Bound | Unrestricted clearance across dialyzer membrane |
| Volume of Distribution (Vd ~0.8 L/kg) | Moderate to Large | Prolonged or repeated dialysis may be required due to Rebound Phenomenon |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Modality | Clearance Rate | Rebound Phenomenon | Primary Indication |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Intermittent Hemodialysis (iHD) | Highest | Significant | Severe Intoxication, Neurotoxicity, Serum Lithium > 5.0 mEq/L |
| Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy (CRRT) | Moderate | Minimal | Hemodynamic Instability, Post-Hemodialysis Rebound Management |
| Conservative Hydration (0.45% Saline) | Lowest | None | Mild Intoxication, Normal Renal Function |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Acute Lithium Intoxication ➔ Assess Serum Lithium Level & Clinical Symptoms ➔ Serum Lithium > 5.0 mEq/L or Severe Neurotoxicity (Seizures, Coma) ➔ Initiate Intermittent Hemodialysis (iHD) ➔ Monitor Serum Lithium Post-Dialysis ➔ Rebound Increase in Serum Lithium ➔ Consider Repeat Hemodialysis or transition to Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy (CRRT) ➔ Serum Lithium < 4.0 mEq/L and Mild Symptoms ➔ Aggressive Isotonic Saline Hydration to promote Renal Clearance.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為單次 Hemodialysis (iHD) 即可完全解決 Lithium Intoxication。
**Analysis**: Lithium 有顯著的 Intracellular 分布，單次 Hemodialysis 後經常發生 Rebound Phenomenon，導致 Serum Lithium 再度飆高。必須持續監測，並準備進行多次透析或轉換為 Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy (CRRT)。
